facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: positive isolation verification failure on TX-3001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-3001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. TX-3001 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 16 October 2024 an incident occurred on TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response, releasing electrical energy held as HV switchgear.
